formsText: Build a form and paste its code on your website (WordPress) — each submission becomes a lead with the “Website” source, UTM tags and page. A repeat submission with the same phone number goes into the existing lead.
noFormsText: Create a form and paste its code on your website.
formNameHint: For the list and the lead comment, e.g. “Home — SMM”
fieldsHint: The keys name, phone, email, company, message, instagram go into the matching lead fields; the rest go into the comment. A phone or email is required.
optionsHint: Options separated by “;”, e.g.: under $500; over $500
serviceHint: If the form is about a specific service
ownerHint: Leave empty to assign the manager of the selected team with the fewest open leads
deleteConfirm: Delete form “{name}”? The code on the website will stop working.
embedHint: WordPress: use the “Custom HTML” block (Gutenberg) or the “HTML” widget in Elementor — paste the code where the form should appear.
linkHint: For a button on the website, the link in your Instagram or Telegram bio, or a QR code.
webhookTitle: URL for plugins (Contact Form 7, Elementor Forms)
webhookHint: If you already have your own form, set this URL (POST) in a webhook plugin. Fields name, phone, email, message; utm_* go into UTM.
metaText: Direct messages and comments arrive in the Inbox, and managers reply right from the CRM. Lead forms from paid ads (Meta Ads) instantly become leads with the campaign and ad.
how1: Instagram — a professional (Business) account linked to a Facebook Page.
how2: developers.facebook.com → Create app (type “Business”) → add the Instagram, Messenger and Webhooks products.
how3: Webhooks: URL — above; verify token — any word (same as META_VERIFY_TOKEN). Subscriptions: Instagram — messages, comments; Page — feed, leadgen.
how4: Get a long-lived Page token (pages_messaging, instagram_manage_messages, instagram_manage_comments, leads_retrieval, pages_read_engagement) → META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
how5: App secret (Settings → Basic) → META_APP_SECRET. Restart the API.
how6: A public domain with HTTPS is required (Beget server). Meta cannot reach a local Mac.
directAuto: Create a lead on the first Direct message
keywordsHint: Comma-separated: price, how much, price list…
title: Integrations
subtitle: Website forms, Instagram, Facebook and paid ads
copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the text manually
defaultSuccess: Thank you! We will contact you shortly.

errors.needContact: A “Phone” or “Email” field is required to contact the client
errors.keyFormat: Key — Latin letters, digits and _ only
errors.noPageToken: Instagram is not connected: META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN is missing in .env

public.pickOption: Select an option from the list
public.tooMany: Too many submissions. Try again in a minute.
public.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
